title: OFAC 50 Percent Rule

authority.cite: OFAC, Revised Guidance on Entities Owned by Persons Whose Property and Interests in Property Are Blocked (Aug. 13, 2014)
OFAC FAQ 399 (aggregation across blocked persons and programs)

notes: Entities owned 50 percent or more in the aggregate, directly or indirectly, by one or more blocked persons are blocked.

Indirect ownership runs only through entities that are themselves 50 percent or more owned by blocked persons; their whole stake then counts (FAQ 401, examples 1-5). Stakes are not multiplied along a chain.
Stakes of persons blocked under different programs are added together (FAQ 399).
Control without 50 percent ownership does not block an entity (FAQ 398). This engine reports it as control_only so it can be reviewed, as OFAC urges caution.
List code BLOCKED is for persons blocked without an SDN entry (for example a blocked government), which OFAC treats as blocked persons.
